choices.reason: The paper names ad quality collectively as primary without ranking text versus image quality; preregistration priority remains unconfirmed because both named OSF API requests were blocked by network permissions. These are different outcomes under the same main specification, session and arm contrast, neither has participant-level SDs or data_stats, and no permitted rule separates them.
